subject: Dedicated capacity: quick sizing probe for Skyline AI
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@skylineai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jul 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity: quick sizing probe for Skyline AI

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. To help us scope a Dedicated fleet proposal that matches Skyline's SLA and cost targets, could you answer a very short sizing probe so we can avoid a follow-up data dump? If it's easier, attach a small sample CSV with recent traffic (see fields below).

Quick questions (5–10 min):
- Typical concurrent active sessions during peak (P95) and off-peak (P50)?
- Prompt average and 95th percentile lengths (tokens) for the user-facing assistant flows vs. background batch jobs?
- Average generated response length and 95th pct response length (tokens)
- Percent of requests that use long-context (>2k tokens) or multimodal attachments?
- Target p99 latency for interactive calls and acceptable cost-per-token range?

If useful, a 1–2 day sample CSV with columns: timestamp, prompt_tokens, response_tokens, is_long_context, request_type (interactive/batch) is perfect — attach to a reply.

We’ll map that to GPU SKUs, batching configuration, and a proposed burst pool. If you’re up for it I can schedule a 30-min walk-through after you share the sample.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: none
From: Samantha Cho <samantha@skylineai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Skyline Procurement <procurement@skylineai.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: quick sizing probe for Skyline AI

Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask. We pulled a 48-hour sample and attached skyline_traffic_sample.csv. High-level answers inline:

- Peak concurrent (P95): ~420 sessions; Off-peak (P50): ~85 sessions.
- Assistant flows (avg prompt): 110 tokens (P95 410). Background batch jobs: avg 1,200 tokens (P95 3,600).
- Avg response length: 220 tokens (P95 1,100).
- Long-context calls: ~4% of total; multimodal attachments: ~1.2%.
- Target p99 interactive latency: 250ms; cost-per-token target: <$0.0009/token (we want to keep monthly bill predictable).

We also noted a weekly spike on Thursdays at 10:00 UTC that doubles interactive concurrency for ~30 minutes.

Attaching: skyline_traffic_sample.csv (48h sample)

Happy to do a walkthrough after you take a look.

— Sam
Director of Product, Skyline AI
Samantha Cho | samantha@skylineai.com

Attachments: skyline_traffic_sample.csv (csv)
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@skylineai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: quick sizing probe for Skyline AI

Sam —

Perfect, thanks for the sample and the numbers — very helpful. Quick read and next steps from our side:

1) Initial sizing hypothesis (based on sample + spike):
   - Sustained baseline concurrency target: 500 sessions (we add 15% headroom to P95)
   - Burst pool for Thursday spikes: additional 500 concurrency for 30 minutes (auto-burst)
   - Model mix: 60% standard 8k-context open model (optimized quantized), 40% long-context LLM for the 4% heavy calls
   - Expected p99 using continuous-batching + small KV cache: ~220–260ms for interactive flows

2) Info we still need to finalize:
   - Confirmation of tokenization scheme (you can share an example prompt-to-token mapping or confirm you're using standard UTF-8 -> byte-pair tokenizer)
   - Any regulatory requirements for private deployment (we saw procurement cc'd — if you need VPC/HSM we should call that out now)

3) Proposed immediate asks: send over your top-3 busiest dates of the last 90 days and a sample of the weekly spike Thursday 10:00 UTC. That will let our capacity planner run a short simulation and return a SKU + cost range.

Shall we schedule a 30-min call Wednesday 10:30am PT to walk the plan with Marissa (pricing) and Karthik (capacity)? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a brief mutual action plan.

Thanks again — quick and useful exchange.

Alex
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Marissa / Karthik —

Forwarding Sam's sample and answers. TL;DR: P95 concurrency ~420, Thursday 10:00 UTC spike doubles concurrency for ~30m, ~4% long-context calls (P95 response tokens ~1.1k), target p99 250ms, cost target <$0.0009/token.

Can you run a quick back-of-envelope to:
- Map the baseline 500-concurrency + 500-burst to likely GPU SKUs (assume our 8k model quantized profile) and give a 3-point cost estimate (conservative/likely/optimistic)?
- Recommend burst auto-scaling policy (time-limited, pre-warming suggestions) and any guardrails for long-context heavy requests so the baseline isn't starved.

I've attached the 48h CSV from Sam. If you want I can loop a customer success contact but I want an internal sketch we can present in the Wed call.

Thanks —
Alex
